pageTitle: Reducing false positives in semantic search

turns.content: Give me practical notes about reducing false positives in semantic search when the goal is better grounding, not a bigger model.

Reducing false positives in semantic search means separating topic overlap from answer-bearing evidence. The archive looked healthy only after we penalized generic brainstorming chunks, boosted exact technical nouns, and kept provider metadata available for debugging. That change reduced hallucinations without using a larger model because the assistant stopped receiving loosely related snippets that sounded plausible but did not answer the question.
